shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Shared focus ring; resolves with the selected palette.

shadows.name: surface-xs
shadows.purpose: Low system elevation. tokens.css owns both light and dark values.

shadows.name: surface-sm
shadows.purpose: Small system elevation. tokens.css owns both light and dark values.

shadows.name: surface-md
shadows.purpose: Medium system elevation. tokens.css owns both light and dark values.

shadows.name: surface-lg
shadows.purpose: Raised menus and overlays, including ProductReportExport; tokens.css supplies each theme.

shadows.name: workspace-card
shadows.purpose: Retained shared baseline in design-workspace.css; operational surfaces use their scoped work shadow.

shadows.name: dashboard-surface
shadows.purpose: Soft dashboard surface and KPI elevation; dashboard.css keeps this resting shadow on KPI hover.

shadows.name: orders-surface
shadows.purpose: Orders applies the operational work elevation to its unified register while tickets and insights retain restrained inner depth.

shadows.name: assistant-surface
shadows.purpose: AI uses soft inner elevation inside a defined frame; prompt accents and composer focus carry the active state.

shadows.name: operations-surface
shadows.purpose: Operational identity panels, joined metric rails and work surfaces; cells inside a joined rail have no outer shadow.

shadows.name: operations-primary-action
shadows.value: 0 7px 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 22%, transparent), inset 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 18%)
shadows.purpose: Primary operational buttons; pressing removes the shadow.

shadows.name: operations-field-focus
shadows.purpose: Operational field focus, alongside the primary border.

shadows.name: operations-dialog
shadows.purpose: Focused operational task dialogs above a blurred backdrop.

shadows.name: operations-popover
shadows.purpose: Teleported operational search, multi-select and calendar menus.

motion.name: composer-feedback
motion.purpose: Composer border and shadow transition; reduced motion removes it.

motion.name: chart-control-feedback
motion.purpose: Time-series tool background and text-color feedback; reduced motion removes it.

motion.name: distribution-row-feedback
motion.purpose: Exact-value row background/border and composition-strip opacity feedback; distribution bar widths update directly.

motion.name: distribution-sector-feedback
motion.purpose: Actual SVG sector opacity and small outward translation for the active share; reduced motion removes it.

motion.name: series-enter
motion.purpose: Existing ECharts SVG time-series entry; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

motion.name: series-update
motion.purpose: ECharts SVG time-series and order-channel data updates; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

motion.name: report-export-overlay
motion.purpose: ProductReportExport opacity and transform transition; reduced motion removes it. Uses the existing surface, border and shadow tokens.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Existing shared button and field background, border, color and focus feedback; reduced motion removes transitions.

motion.name: overview-segment-feedback
motion.purpose: Overview metric selector background, text and low-shadow feedback; reduced motion removes transitions.

motion.name: channel-enter
motion.purpose: OrderChannelChart SVG column entry; reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: kitchen-bar-feedback
motion.purpose: KitchenSpeed actual-time bar width changes on a stable target-inclusive scale; reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: radar-opacity-feedback
motion.purpose: Radar series opacity changes; the dashboard reduced-motion rule removes descendant transitions.

motion.name: order-ticket-feedback
motion.purpose: Ticket border and shadow feedback; reduced motion removes transitions.

motion.name: reply-reveal-step
motion.purpose: Presentation-only prefix updates after the complete JSON answer is stored; word and Markdown boundaries preserve readable content.

motion.name: reply-reveal-duration
motion.purpose: Duration clamps content length / 240 * 1000ms. Show full answer ends it; reduced motion, hidden documents and content above 60000 characters show immediately.

motion.name: reply-cursor
motion.purpose: Cursor opacity cycle only during the visual reveal with no reduced-motion preference; it is not backend streaming.

motion.name: work-ease
motion.purpose: Scoped operational color, border, elevation and small hover/press feedback.

motion.name: operations-feedback
motion.purpose: Controls and related navigation; reduced motion removes transitions.

motion.name: login-station
motion.purpose: Small vertical movement of the Alpha POS hub only; the pause control and reduced motion stop it.

motion.name: operations-row-feedback
motion.purpose: Register-row tint and inset edge; records have no repeated entrance choreography.

motion.name: operations-metric-feedback
motion.purpose: Metric tint and inset hover edge within a joined rail.

motion.name: operations-dialog-transition
motion.purpose: Dialog/backdrop opacity and dialog transform only; reduced motion removes it. Inline dialogs use the matching keyframes.

quantity.purpose: JetBrains Mono for exact chart rows and accounting values; dashboard headline totals use Hanken Grotesk.

dashboard-heading.purpose: The renewed continuous-dashboard page heading; responsive size adjustments remain in dashboard.css.

dashboard-total.purpose: Tabular Hanken figures in the four opening cards; reduces to 22px on phones.

dashboard-metric.purpose: Tabular Hanken figures in separate tinted chapter cards; names use the smaller sans-serif treatment.

operations-heading.purpose: Command-panel title in Hanken Grotesk; 30–38px on desktop, 25px at 700px and 23px at 360px.

operations-metric.purpose: Tabular Hanken values in joined summary rails; phone values step down to 23px and 21px. Accounting precision and unavailable values remain unchanged.

components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--work-control,13px);font:650 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--shadow-focus,0 0 0 3px rgb(59 130 246 / 28%))}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(.5px)}.ds-btn-primary{background:var(--primary,#2563eb);color:var(--on-primary,#fff)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--primary-hover,#1d4ed8)}.ds-btn-primary:active{background:var(--primary-active,#1e40af)}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:none}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:none}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px}}.ds-btn-primary{transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-btn-primary{box-shadow:0 7px 16px color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#2563eb) 22%,transparent),inset 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 18%)}@media(hover:hover){.ds-btn-primary:not([disabled]):hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99);box-shadow:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Text input
components.description: Operational text field and inline invalid state, with linked labels, error text and the four-pixel focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field-examples{display:grid;gap:18px}.ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--text,#17243b);font:700 11px/1.45 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);letter-spacing:.025em}.ds-input{min-height:46px;min-width:0;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--work-line,color-mix(in srgb,var(--text,#17243b) 11%,var(--surface,#fff)));border-radius:var(--work-control,13px);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#17243b);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgb(15 28 20 / 3%);font:400 14px var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);letter-spacing:normal;transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--work-line-strong,color-mix(in srgb,var(--text,#17243b) 17%,var(--surface,#fff)));background:var(--work-raised,color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface,#fff) 97%,var(--primary,#2563eb)))}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary,#2563eb);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--primary-ring),0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#2563eb) 9%,transparent)}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--error,#c8372a)}.ds-field-error{color:var(--error-strong,#a82c21);font:400 11px/1.5 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);letter-spacing:normal}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:768px){.ds-input{font-size:16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-work-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;padding:1px;border-radius:var(--work-radius,22px);background:var(--work-line,color-mix(in srgb,var(--text,#17243b) 11%,var(--surface,#fff)));box-shadow:var(--work-shadow,0 1px 2px rgb(15 28 20 / 4%),0 14px 34px rgb(15 28 20 / 7%));overflow:hidden}.ds-work-metric{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:138px;padding:21px 22px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#17243b);box-shadow:none;font:500 11px/1.5 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-work-metric:hover{z-index:1;background:var(--work-raised,color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface,#fff) 97%,var(--primary,#2563eb)));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--primary-border)}.ds-work-metric>span{color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a);font-size:11px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.035em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-work-metric strong{display:block;margin-top:18px;font:700 31px/1.18 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-work-metric p{margin:9px 0 0;color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a);font-size:11px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-work-rail{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));border-radius:18px}.ds-work-metric{min-height:118px;padding:15px}.ds-work-metric:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:90px}.ds-work-metric>span{font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.4}.ds-work-metric strong{font-size:23px}}@media(max-width:360px){.ds-work-metric{padding:12px}.ds-work-metric strong{font-size:21px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-work-metric{transition:none}}:host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-work-rail{--work-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 24%),0 18px 44px rgb(0 0 0 / 24%)}

components.name: Distribution row
components.description: Exact-value chart row with hover preview, visible keyboard focus and pinned selection. Dashes are preview placeholders; production values and percentages come from the complete supplied dataset.
components.css: .ds-distribution-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:10px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:4px 9px;text-align:left;width:100%;min-height:52px;min-width:0;padding:9px 7px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms,border-color 150ms}.ds-distribution-row:hover{background:var(--surface-2,#f7f9fd)}.ds-distribution-row[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#2563eb) 40%,var(--border,#dbe3f0));background:var(--primary-weak,#ebf2ff)}.ds-distribution-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#2563eb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-distribution-marker{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c1,#2563eb) 55%,white),var(--c1,#2563eb))}.ds-distribution-title{color:var(--text,#17243b);font:500 12px/1.4 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-distribution-percent{color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a);font:500 11px var(--font-mono,"JetBrains Mono",monospace);text-align:right}.ds-distribution-value{grid-column:2/-1;display:flex;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;color:var(--text,#17243b);font:400 12px var(--font-mono,"JetBrains Mono",monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-distribution-value small{color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a);font:10px var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-distribution-row{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-dashboard-kpi{--ds-metric-color:var(--chart-revenue,var(--primary,#2563eb));position:relative;min-width:0;padding:18px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ds-metric-color) 45%,var(--dash-edge,var(--border,#dbe3f0)));border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ds-metric-color) 8%,var(--surface,#fff)),var(--surface,#fff));box-shadow:var(--dash-shadow,0 2px 3px -2px #15162512,0 8px 24px -18px #15162530);color:var(--text,#17243b);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif)}.ds-dashboard-kpi-select{position:absolute;z-index:1;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:inherit;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-dashboard-kpi-select:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#2563eb) 3%,transparent)}.ds-dashboard-kpi-select:focus-visible{border-radius:10px;outline:2px solid var(--primary,#2563eb);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-dashboard-kpi-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;min-height:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:550}.ds-dashboard-kpi-head svg{color:var(--primary,#2563eb)}.ds-dashboard-kpi-value{display:flex;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin:12px 0 8px;font:600 29px/1.3 var(--font-sans,"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.03em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-dashboard-kpi-value small{font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a)}.ds-dashboard-kpi-scope{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-secondary,#52627a)}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-dashboard-kpi{padding:14px}.ds-dashboard-kpi-head{font-size:11px}.ds-dashboard-kpi-value{font-size:22px;margin:6px 0 4px}}

components.name: Rounded distribution sectors

narrative.overview:
Alpha POS makes restaurant operations composed, tactile and fast. Integrated identity panels pair solid primary symbol tiles with clear titles, actions and related-route rails. Joined metrics show actual values above elevated registers and focused editing surfaces. Product and category catalogs, dining areas, warehouse tasks and settings retain layouts suited to their work within this shared hierarchy.

The existing Blue and Forest identities, all six palettes and the established fonts remain shared. Dashboard retains its approved soft surfaces, tinted summaries, shaded data marks and separated ring sectors, now led by a framed identity panel and floating section navigator. Orders joins the operational command surface while retaining its ticket, table and detail workflows. AI retains its approved conversation layout with a more defined frame, prompt accents and focused composer. Operational styling is an explicit page opt-in; Dashboard, AI and the shared shell keep their established compositions.
keyCharacteristics: Integrated identity panels and connected task navigation.
Joined actual-value metric rails and elevated registers.
Expandable phone records, collapsible filters and bottom-sheet forms.
Refined Dashboard and AI compositions, with Orders in the operational hierarchy.
Restrained motion and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Read canonical tokens; do not hard-code a second palette inside a page.

rules.name: The Surface Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep operational depth scoped to WorkspacePage and its dialog/popover context; preserve the domain-specific Dashboard and AI structures with their scoped elevation.

dos: Do preserve fields, actions, permissions, translations, date semantics and backend contracts.
Do keep loading, error, empty, stale and populated states distinct; keep all chart categories accessible.
Do retain every register field and action in phone records and details, with reachable 44px controls.
Do test full control visibility and long labels at 320px as well as 390px.
Do keep related-page navigation permission-filtered and operational styling explicitly scoped.
Do keep chart share scope visible and every returned category, product and person reachable through exact-value controls.
Do keep order-channel colors consistent and chart tags readable across all six light/dark palettes.
Do keep preparation targets as markers on the actual-time scale, so overruns remain visible.
Do keep accounting-report money exact and incomplete historical cost visible through warnings and unavailable-value dashes.
donts: Don't invent live-looking totals or replace missing financial values with zero.
Don't turn a displayed subset into a period-wide denominator or normalized staff measures into performance scores.
Don't substitute colored dialog headers for semantic symbols, hide validation errors or repeat record entrances.
Don't copy obsolete decorative eyebrows, oversized blank KPI stacks or clipped composer layouts.
